name: mirage
text: Logged as LG1. You're right that it shouldn't happen: with live set to GitHub the phone is meant to run no live lane and no sockets, only Novig's feed for bids. I can see a few places where the phone still does live work (when the engine isn't confirmed running live, in Live-only mode, and the live bid desk), but I haven't found the cause yet. To pin it down: after the next lag or crash, open Settings > Diagnostics & about and share the report. Its Memory section shows what's using the phone's memory. Which Live setting is selected when it lags, GitHub or Phone, and is Live-only mode on?
